caption: The video captures an overhead close-up of a dark blue bowl filled with clear water and several floating ice cubes. A vertical oval cube sits at the left, a rounded mass occupies the centre, and a diagonal cube lies toward the right, with a small pointed fragment near the rim and a squarish piece lower down. The bowl rests on a reflective surface, while a white vertical strip and a green background region remain fixed along the right edge of the frame. The ice pieces are largely stationary, with only minor apparent shifts in edge highlights; no clear translation, rotation, contact, or disappearance is evident. The camera framing appears stable, and subtle shimmering of specular highlights on the water and ice is visible. A faint transient circular highlight appears near the central ice, reflecting light or surface variation rather than movement of the cubes.
